messages:
jordana: Heads up — PR #59988 is ready for review, small change to kv prefetch that should reduce OOMs on 8GB cards. I need runtime + infra + security signoff before a canary. Can folks please take a quick look? Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/59988 :pray:
kevin: quick skimed — looks fine overall. main concern is the eviction heuristics interacting with prefetch. can you add a note in the PR description about fallbacks? :thinking_face:
jordana: good call. added a short note in the PR about fallback order and why max_inflight is conservative for now. also added a perf test section (results attached).
ash: @jordana can you paste the config delta here? easier for a quick eyeball than opening the full diff.
jordana: sure — here's the change (YAML):
```yaml
kv_prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 20
  max_inflight: 8
  eviction_margin_percent: 12
```
kevin: thanks — margin looks sane. two questions: 1) does this affect warm starts for dedicated pools? 2) do we need a feature flag to roll back quickly?
sophie: adding infra/security perspective — @eng-infra please check allocation behaviour during heavy tails; @eng-security, is there any new surface from prefetch metrics being emitted?
lex: from infra side i can own the canary and watch eviction counters. will need the canary window (~30m) and a fallback plan.
mike-ci-bot: CI passed — unit + integration: 128 tests, 0 failures.
jordana: thanks @lex — proposed canary tomorrow 09:30 UTC, 30m window. fallback plan: revert to previous kv_prefetch.max_inflight=16 if eviction_rate > 0.8% over 10m. added steps in the PR runbook.
kevin: @eng-security can you confirm telemetry exposes eviction_rate and won't leak any PII?
sophie: security ok — eviction_rate is aggregate metric, no user ids. i'm +1 from security.
ash: runtime ping — @runtime-team can someone review the runtime allocation/lock path? small concern around races when prefetch triggers while shard is reassigning.
jordana: added a brief comment in the code about the lock ordering. hoping runtime can confirm it's safe.
kevin: i'm happy to take runtime review if nobody else is free, but might be slightly delayed till this afternoon. if you need faster, @ash?
ash: i can take a look in the next 30m. will post inline comments if i see anything.
jordana: amazing, thank you. if both runtime + infra + security are +1 by EOD we can schedule the canary.
lex: noted — i'll standby to kick off canary and monitor dashboards. cc: @oncall (just FYI).
kevin: small nit: please include the exact metric names in the PR runbook so SRE dashboards can be linked in the rollback steps.
jordana: done. added links to: grafana/redwood/eviction-overview and grafana/redwood/kv-prefetch.
ash: left 2 tiny comments in the diff (nits). nothing blocking.
jordana: thanks all. i'll re-request reviewers on the PR after addressing nits. please reply here if you want the merge slot pinned — otherwise i'll book the default Tue 10:00 UTC slot. :calendar:
